pattern.crimePattern: a transporter kills the night nurse guarding his drunk brother's blood-alcohol sample after a fatal crash, takes the sample and wets the floor to stage a slip
pattern.notes: Fictional people and hospital. The pedestrian killed in the crash (Mzee Bonsa Tura, 64) is offstage and told only in the traffic officer's report. The empty rack slot is the absence: a chain-of-custody book that says what should be there.

ob.text: The morning shift at Moyale sub-county hospital reports a night nurse found dead on the floor of the laboratory annex: Kavata Mutua (30). Suspected fall on a wet floor.

reconstruction.text: Friday, 01:30. Yusuf, drunk, drives the family pickup into Mzee Bonsa Tura, walking home from night prayers, and hits a pole. Cpl. Galgallo brings him to casualty and asks for a blood-alcohol sample.
02:10. Kavata takes it, seals it, logs it and puts it in slot B4 for the 06:00 vehicle. Mahat arrives at 02:40 asking where it goes. At 03:00 he offers her KSh 100,000 at the lab door. She refuses.
03:20. He calls the watchman; at 03:25 he sends him KSh 5,000. At 03:40 Adano opens the annex side door "for a family matter" and goes to the gate.
Mahat comes in as Kavata checks the fridge. He reaches for the rack; she holds on. He strikes her with the steel extinguisher from the corridor.

He takes the tube from B4, tears off its label, empties the corridor jerrycan around her, wipes the extinguisher and stands it in the corner. At 03:55 he is back beside his brother's bed, his sleeves wet.

clockPlan.note: Two stamps: records on Mahat's line and a warrant on his car. Detain Mahat after the search; he refuses prints, so they are taken in detention. Prints (6 h + 4) and blood (12 h + 4) come back inside 24 h.

ui.beatNotes: The rack. The fridge view shows the rack as a grid of slots with tube icons; the custody book sits beside it. Dragging each book line onto its slot fills the grid. B4 stays empty, and the empty square pulses once.
